service_request.problem_description: Furnace is vibrating violently and emitting a heavy burning plastic smell in the basement.

history.content: Hello! Welcome to Apex Heating & Air Conditioning. How can we help your home stay comfortable today?
My furnace is making a loud buzzing sound and there's a strong burning plastic smell in the basement!

Please step away from the basement immediately and shut off the furnace breaker if it is safe to do so. We have a 24/7 emergency dispatch team on call in Denver. Are you the homeowner, and what is your address?
Yes, I own the home. I'm Marcus Vance at 742 Evergreen Terrace, Denver. My number is 303-555-0199.
Got it Marcus. I have dispatched an emergency high-priority alert to our on-call technician. Our emergency diagnostic fee is $189. A technician is on their way within 90 minutes.
